# Lutris fixture provenance
Original synthetic SQL/YAML, no personal launcher data. Schema and field meanings
checked against Lutris database/schema.py, config.py, settings.py and game.py
on 27 October 2026 (https://github.com/lutris/lutris). These GPL-3.0 files are
format references only; no code or tests were copied. Playtime is decimal hours.
The native old config dir and Flatpak new data/games dir are both represented;
configpath is the per-game YAML filename stem. Local row ids intentionally collide.
